title: The Lambs in the Cold Night
offer: A late frost tonight, and my ewes had their lambs today! Bring two warm blankets from Sæunn in Guldvik, and a jug of milk from the horse farm, before the night falls.

steps.load_say: My thickest wool blankets. Wrap the little ones well!
Warm milk for the lambs. Row fast, so it stays warm!

steps.say: Wrapped up and full of milk, the lambs sleep by the fire. Not one of them is cold. Thank you!

fact: Lambs are born in spring; a cold night is the shepherd's biggest worry.
